name: RaceDay CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:

  # ==========================================
  # PART 1 - Validate required documentation
  # ==========================================
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate required Part 1 files
        run: |
          test -f docs/ERD.pdf
          test -f docs/API.pdf
          test -f docs/RaceDayDB.sql
          echo "All required Part 1 documents are present."

  # ==========================================
  # PART 2 - Build API and run automated tests
  # ==========================================
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up .NET 10
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore "part 2/RaceDay.slnx"

      - name: Build RaceDay solution
        run: dotnet build "part 2/RaceDay.slnx" --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run automated tests
        run: dotnet test "part 2/RaceDayAPI.Tests/RaceDayAPI.Tests.csproj" --configuration Release --no-restore
